quotations.old_english: Ðone ðe se eádiga Benedictus ná handlunge ac on beseónde fram his bendum álýsde
quotations.english: whom the blessed Benedict not by touching him, but by looking on him, had released from his bonds

source_text: handlung, e; f. Touching, handling :-- Ðone ðe se eádiga Benedictus ná handlunge ac on beseónde fram his bendum álýsde whom the blessed Benedict not by touching him, but by looking on him, had released from his bonds, Homl. Th. ii. 182, 4.
